config.label: WHOOP OAuth client ID
config.description: WHOOP OAuth client ID. Optional when configured with whoop-mcp-server setup.

config.label: WHOOP OAuth client secret
config.description: WHOOP OAuth client secret. Prefer whoop-mcp-server setup so this secret is stored in ~/.whoop-mcp/config.json instead of MCP client config.

config.label: Redirect URI configured in the WHOOP Developer Dashboard
config.description: Redirect URI configured in the WHOOP Developer Dashboard. Optional when configured with whoop-mcp-server setup.

config.label: Optional local path for OAuth tokens
config.description: Optional local path for OAuth tokens. Defaults to ~/.whoop-mcp/tokens.json.

config.label: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw
config.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured.

config.label: Optional SQLite cache toggle
config.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

config.label: Optional local SQLite cache path
config.description: Optional local SQLite cache path. Defaults to ~/.whoop-mcp/cache.sqlite.
